title: Updates
progress: Updating SterraCode. Your workspace will reconnect when it is ready.
recoveryFailed: Recovery needs attention. Use the local management command and follow the recovery guide.
incompatible: A supported migration path or a newer local updater is required.
automatic: Automatically install all compatible stable releases, including major versions.
unmanaged: This installation has no Docker updater. Follow the migration guide before transferring an existing source installation.
error: The update action is unavailable. Check the local updater status and compatibility.
maintenance: An update is preparing. New changes are temporarily paused.
checkFailed: The release service is unavailable. Your workspace continues to work.
